verdict.rationale: The SDK's core interface is natural-language prompts routed through Claude's agent loop, which then autonomously invokes tools, edits files, runs commands, and asks clarifying questions in plain language (e.g., canUseTool/AskUserQuestion flow). Community usage (e.g., `claude -p` headless workflows) confirms real-world natural-language-driven operation, though some note the harness/DX around it is rough.
